description.value: Moore's Bakery of Kerrisdale is one of Vancouver's oldest storefronts, operating since the 1930s with Dutch and British baking traditions passed down through a family-owned business. The bakery produces handmade breads, buns, pastries, cakes, cookies, and savoury items fresh daily on site. A touring cyclist passing through Kerrisdale will find a genuine neighbourhood institution offering hearty baked goods well suited for fuelling a ride.
